DALLAS–FORT WORTH AREA

Doctor appointments

Non-emergency rides to scheduled medical visits and outpatient appointments.

Planning your trip

Provide the time you need to arrive, not just the appointment start time. Discuss return transportation and any companion or mobility needs when requesting your trip.

What time should I request pickup?

Share your required arrival time and both addresses. The team can review travel time and boarding needs before confirming pickup.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For a scheduled, non-emergency medical or outpatient visit when a passenger needs transportation assistance.

How the journey is planned

A successful appointment trip starts with the clinic’s required arrival time, which may be earlier than the appointment itself. Provide the correct building and entrance, boarding needs and whether someone will accompany the passenger. Discuss the return separately, especially when the length of the appointment is uncertain.

What we plan with you

  • Planning around the required arrival time
  • Review of clinic access and mobility needs
  • One-way or requested return coordination

Have these details ready

  • Clinic name, address and entrance
  • Required check-in time
  • Return estimate and companion request

Questions about this service

Will the driver wait during my appointment?

Ask when requesting the trip. A scheduled return, a call-when-ready pickup and a driver waiting on site are different arrangements; waiting availability and charges require team confirmation.

Can I use this after sedation?

Ask the clinic what escort and discharge arrangements it requires. Transportation alone may not meet its responsible-adult policy; the clinic and transportation team must confirm the plan.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Sources for general planning guidance
  • Dream Care Rides: NEMT guide
  • Mobility Transportation Services: patient FAQs

Details to have ready

  • Appointment location and required arrival
  • Walking or wheelchair assistance
  • Return ride and companion arrangements

How to arrange a ride

Choose doctor appointments and prepare the trip details. The transportation team must review your request, vehicle suitability and availability before confirming pickup. A calendar appointment or prepared request alone does not confirm transportation.
